patch_description: All programs plateau around min_area 0.02 because single-point pattern search gets stuck in shallow local optima: moving one point at a time is myopic when the minimum-area (bottleneck) triangle constrains 3 points simultaneously. The known strong heuristic for Heilbronn-type problems is to move the points of the *smallest* triangles along their signed-area gradients (all three vertices of a bottleneck triangle together), which directly raises the constrained minimum. I add: (1) a vectorized bottleneck gradient move (move up to 3 bottleneck points along the gradient of their triangle areas), (2) an annealing reheat loop per seed that restarts from the best-so-far configuration when progress stalls (targeting the 0.02 plateau), and (3) keep the pattern-search polish as a final refinement. This directly addresses the plateau at 0.02 and should push combined_score above 1.0 while keeping determinism and modest runtime.
